method: Independent visual inspection using view_image of25 root-captured native Tauri screenshots. No app interaction or app code/data mutations by this agent.
scope: Screenshots01–25 only;01–06wide,07–25logical1024x768(retina captures2048x1536). Screenshot03 has no caught drawer alert and is excluded from alert conclusions.

limitations: No square-checkout inference from this wide capture.

findings.title: Touch keyboard survives dismissal of the customer form
findings.observation: The Add/Edit customer modal is absent, yet its Name editor and keyboard remain over the Customers list. Background remains blurred and the editor targets an invisible field.
findings.impact: User cannot immediately interact with visible list normally and may continue typing into a stale form target.
findings.recommendation: Close and detach touch keyboard whenever the owning modal closes, saves, navigates or is destroyed. Restore focus to an existing control.

findings.title: Period-report header close button renders without any visible icon
findings.observation: Top-right rounded button is entirely blank on both Till X and whole-system previews; footer Close remains visible.
findings.impact: Header control's purpose is visually undiscoverable. This is not evidence its handler fails.
findings.recommendation: Render a visible close X with explicit width,height,stroke and current text color; check native WebView output.

findings.title: Goods Menu Manager shows only one row per list at square size
findings.observation: Available items and selected-order lists each have room for only one full row, despite a large catalog. Modal overhead uses most space.
findings.impact: Browsing and ordering several selections requires repeated scrolling and loses context.
findings.recommendation: Give list panes a larger minimum/available height and shorten explanatory/header spacing, retaining visible sticky footer.

findings.title: Add Page is only partially visible in Scale Tile Designer toolbar
findings.observation: The tab strip ends midway through '+Add Page'; a horizontal scrollbar is visible while edit/delete actions sit outside it.
findings.impact: Page creation action is easy to overlook, though horizontal scrolling can expose it.
findings.recommendation: Keep Add Page as a fixed toolbar action outside the tab scroller or expose a clear overflow menu.

findings.title: Attendance summary shows Clocked in0 while current user is visibly clocked in
findings.observation: Current user panel says Clocked in with885h51m and Clock Out action; unqualified Clocked in summary says0.
findings.impact: Manager can interpret0 as nobody currently working, even though only sessions whose clock-in falls within selected dates are counted.
findings.recommendation: Use global current-open count for this tile, or label it explicitly as open sessions among filtered records.

findings.title: Attendance-only role tab is truncated at square width
findings.observation: Tab reads Attendanc… while other roles are fully visible. Selected role detail below is readable.
findings.impact: Minor consistency/discoverability issue; selected role remains identifiable.
findings.recommendation: Allow a wrapped role label, shorten tab badge, or use a full short label such as Attendance.

overall: Most captured square management pages fit their important actions using visible vertical scroll containers. No broad table/modal horizontal overflow was observed. Main confirmed visual defects are orphan touch-keyboard lifecycle and blank period-report header close icon. Remaining findings concern cramped/discoverable controls or unclear labels.
functionalLimit: Screenshots do not establish that every button works, saved writes are correct, printers work, provider cancellation succeeds or in-progress sync finishes.
